_meta.placement: cap index = (N*1 + E*2 + S*4 + W*8) * block^2 + (row % block) * block + (column % block), where the mask bit is set when that neighbour is also wall and row/column are the cell's map position. The mask picks the shape, the position picks which cut of the wrapping patch -- without the position term every wall cell is the same pixels and the mass reads as a lattice. Use the cap when the cell below is wall. When the cell below is floor use face index = (W*1 + E*2) * block + (column % block), offset by face_range[0].

formula.cap: index = (N*1 + E*2 + S*4 + W*8) * block^2 + (row % block) * block + (column % block)
formula.when: Use the cap where the cell BELOW is wall; use the face where the cell below is floor.
